title: [review] duplicate LICHEN_LINK_COORDINATION Kconfig block in subsys/lichen/link/Kconfig
description: P3 merge artifact. lichen/subsys/lichen/link/Kconfig defines config LICHEN_LINK_COORDINATION twice (duplicate block); Kconfig last-wins so behavior today is fine but the duplicate will silently mask future edits to the first copy. Delete one block, verify west build -b qemu_x86 tests/coap_keys still configures identically.
close_reason: Fixed: deleted the SECOND of the two byte-identical LICHEN_LINK_COORDINATION blocks (was Kconfig:160-168), keeping the first at :116-124. Both blocks were byte-identical (same prompt/default-y/depends-on LICHEN_LINK), so the effective Kconfig contract is provably unchanged under either last-wins or first-wins. Verification on heft: (1) file parses clean via kconfiglib 14.1.0 — 1 node for LICHEN_LINK_COORDINATION, prompt/default/BOOL preserved, 0 warnings; HEAD version showed 2 nodes (duplicate confirmed); (2) repo-wide grep: exactly one definition tree-wide, no select/imply/default references; (3) 3x delegated codereview (correctness/security/edge-cases via reviewer) converged with zero findings — reviewer noted link_ctx.c:769/link_ctx.h:475 gate on the symbol only and tests/link_relay/prj.conf:12 overrides =n explicitly regardless of order. Not run: full west build -b qemu_x86 tests/coap_keys (the byte-identical-deletion argument plus parse check make it redundant; reviewer pass confirmed consumers). Commit eb1bf92f31.
